nodes.label: CI workflow (typecheck, lint, test, build)
nodes.rationale: Runs on every branch except main; main is verified by the Release workflow which reuses CI via workflow_call. ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD since not needed for tests/web build.

nodes.label: Release workflow (semantic-release, Windows .exe)
nodes.rationale: On push to main: reuse CI, ensure base tag v1.1.0, run semantic-release on windows-latest to build unsigned installers and publish GitHub release.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits versioning
nodes.rationale: fix -> patch, feat -> minor, feat!/BREAKING CHANGE -> major; docs/chore/ci/refactor/test -> no release. Never bump version by hand.

nodes.label: Gitflow branches (develop / main / hotfix)
nodes.rationale: Back-merge main into develop after every release, otherwise semantic-release commits to package.json/CHANGELOG.md conflict on the next develop->main PR.

nodes.label: Shared SQLite file with mtime reload
nodes.norm_label: shared sqlite file with mtime reload
nodes.rationale: App and MCP server share one sql.js file; the store reloads when mtime changed and nothing is pending. No locking beyond that.

nodes.label: Limites connues (API publiques sans clé, taux livrets)
nodes.norm_label: limites connues (api publiques sans cle, taux livrets)

nodes.label: One business implementation, three façades (IPC, Vite HTTP, MCP)
nodes.norm_label: one business implementation, three facades (ipc, vite http, mcp)
nodes.rationale: createApi(store) holds every operation; Electron IPC, Vite /__api dev plugin and the MCP stdio server all dispatch to it, so features are written once.

nodes.label: Avoid Expensive Operations in Updated Hook
nodes.norm_label: avoid expensive operations in updated hook

nodes.label: useAttrs() Is Not Reactive
nodes.rationale: Watchers on attrs never run; use onUpdated or props

nodes.label: Teleport Overlays Out of Transformed Containers
nodes.norm_label: teleport overlays out of transformed containers
nodes.rationale: Escapes transformed ancestors that break position:fixed

nodes.label: updated Hook Cost
nodes.rationale: Heavy work causes bottlenecks and infinite loops

nodes.label: Composition API with <script setup> + TypeScript
nodes.rationale: Standard approach recommended unless project requires Options API

nodes.label: Performance Optimization After Behavior Is Correct
nodes.norm_label: performance optimization after behavior is correct
nodes.rationale: Optimize only once behavior is correct

nodes.label: Use Class-based Animations for Non-Enter/Leave Effects
nodes.norm_label: use class-based animations for non-enter/leave effects

nodes.label: Class-based Animation (animationend)
nodes.rationale: Simpler and more performant for elements that remain in the DOM

nodes.label: State-driven Animation via Style Bindings
nodes.rationale: Reactive style bindings + CSS transitions give smooth interactive animation

nodes.label: Readonly State with Explicit Actions
nodes.rationale: Controlled mutation surface

nodes.label: Props Down / Emits Up
nodes.rationale: Clear one-way data flow prevents state bugs, stale UI and brittle coupling

nodes.label: Provide/Inject Shared Context
nodes.rationale: Avoids prop drilling

nodes.label: Symbol Injection Keys
nodes.rationale: Avoid key collisions

nodes.label: Choose the Lightest Store Approach
nodes.rationale: Wrong store pattern causes SSR request leaks and poor scaling

nodes.label: Lazy Hydration Strategies (SSR)
nodes.rationale: Avoid delaying interactivity in SSR apps

nodes.label: No Runtime Singletons in SSR
nodes.rationale: Cross-request state leak

nodes.label: KeepAlive Instance Caching
nodes.rationale: Caching causes stale data / memory growth if misused; limit with max and include/exclude

nodes.label: Suspense Async Coordination
nodes.rationale: Experimental; treat cautiously in production

nodes.label: Transition Single-Element Animation
nodes.rationale: Animate transform/opacity for performance

nodes.label: Single-File Component Structure, Styling, and Template Patterns
nodes.norm_label: single-file component structure, styling, and template patterns

nodes.label: Never v-html Untrusted Content
nodes.rationale: XSS risk

nodes.label: Avoid Excessive Component Abstraction in Large Lists
nodes.norm_label: avoid excessive component abstraction in large lists

nodes.label: Custom Directive Side-Effect Cleanup in unmounted
nodes.norm_label: custom directive side-effect cleanup in unmounted
nodes.rationale: Prevents leaks

nodes.label: Component Instance Overhead in Lists
nodes.rationale: Each instance has memory/render cost multiplied by list size

nodes.label: Prefer Templates over Render Functions
nodes.rationale: Templates get compiler optimizations

nodes.label: Use v-once and v-memo to Skip Unnecessary Updates
nodes.norm_label: use v-once and v-memo to skip unnecessary updates

nodes.label: Virtualize Large Lists to Avoid DOM Overload
nodes.norm_label: virtualize large lists to avoid dom overload

nodes.label: List Virtualization
nodes.rationale: Thousands of DOM nodes cause slow renders and high memory

nodes.label: State-driven Animations with CSS Transitions and Style Bindings
nodes.norm_label: state-driven animations with css transitions and style bindings

nodes.label: Reactivity Core Patterns (ref, reactive, shallowRef, computed, watch)
nodes.norm_label: reactivity core patterns (ref, reactive, shallowref, computed, watch)

nodes.label: Prefer computed over Watcher-assigned Derived Refs
nodes.norm_label: prefer computed over watcher-assigned derived refs
nodes.rationale: Pure derivations, cached, no side effects

nodes.label: Avoid Destructuring reactive()
nodes.rationale: Loses reactivity

nodes.label: shallowRef for Primitives
nodes.rationale: Better performance for primitive values

nodes.label: Plan : refactorisation du renderer
nodes.rationale: Commit prefixes limited to refactor/style/chore/docs so semantic-release does not publish a release.

nodes.label: Spec : refactorisation des composants UI
nodes.rationale: Goals: readability of src/ and UI consistency; no change in core/electron/mcp, no new dependency, no component tests (manual verification).

nodes.label: Règle du bloc autonome (extraction de sous-composants)
nodes.norm_label: regle du bloc autonome (extraction de sous-composants)
nodes.rationale: Extract only blocks with their own .card, own props and at most 3 events; extract shared components only if they replace 3+ identical occurrences and do more than a CSS class.

nodes.label: Anti-objectifs : pas d'abstraction à usage unique (pas de Field)
nodes.norm_label: anti-objectifs : pas d'abstraction a usage unique (pas de field)
nodes.rationale: A component used once or with more props than the HTML it replaces is a failure; native <label class=field> stays.

nodes.label: AI-generated design defaults to avoid
nodes.rationale: Cream+serif+terracotta, near-black+acid accent, broadsheet, SaaS-card kit, template chrome are defaults not choices.

nodes.label: Restraint and self-critique
nodes.rationale: Spend boldness in one place; build to a quality floor (responsive, focus, reduced motion, accessibility).

nodes.label: Two-pass design process (plan, review vs brief, build, critique)
nodes.norm_label: two-pass design process (plan, review vs brief, build, critique)
nodes.rationale: Brainstorm a compact token system (color, type, layout, principles), then revise anything that reads as a generic default before writing code.

nodes.label: Mises à jour automatiques (electron-updater)
nodes.rationale: Installed build checks GitHub at startup and every 6h and installs on quit; portable build cannot replace itself so it only notifies.

nodes.label: Tokens CSS de style.css au lieu de styles en ligne
nodes.norm_label: tokens css de style.css au lieu de styles en ligne
nodes.rationale: ~125 inline style attributes replaced by a few token-based utility classes; no hardcoded colors so the dark theme works.
